messages:
alice: Quick owners-roundup — final sweep before cutoff at 18:00 PT. Please call out ownership for these items: version bump PR, changelog tidy, security stamp, docs check, and smoke test owner.
ben: I can take the version bump and tag. PR #4278 is ready, just awaiting a tiny change from tests.
priya: Pinged on the change, @ben. I ran the unit suite locally and one flaky test popped (`session_timeout_test`). Fix coming in a follow-up.
marco: I'll own the changelog scrub. Will do a pass in the next 30m and push a markdown cleanup.
dana: I can do docs signoff once changelog is in. Want me to verify crosslinks + upgrade notes?
alice: Yes please, @dana — focus on the migration note for dedicated/deploy differences. Also confirm the CLI examples still match the bump.
ben: Pushing updated PR now. Command I ran: ```git checkout release/v0.23 && git pull origin main && git merge --no-ff release-bump-4278 && git push origin release/v0.23```
priya: Test fix pushed in #4281. Added a small sleep in the mock timer — flaky suppressed. Ran 3x locally.
marco: Changelog draft pushed: https://our-docs.internal/changelogs/v0.23.md — please eyeball for wording.
dana: Looked at changelog, left 2 suggestions inline. Also flagged the breaking change note for embeddings API.
alice: Security review — @security please confirm if we have an S-SIG stamp for the release. @marco, is there any new surface area?
ben: No new infra surface changes. Just model-version label updates.
priya: @alice I ran the dependency scan (Snyk) and a minor version alert came up for package `fastjson` — low severity. I opened ticket SEC-213. Not blocking.
dana: Docs signoff given pending changelog merge. :white_check_mark:
marco: Changelog merged. @ben you can proceed with the tag when ready.
ben: Tag pushed: `v0.23.0-rc1` — deploy-bot should pick this up.
deploy-bot: deploy-plan posted: https://deploys.internal/plan/2061500000 — canary in staging in ~10m, rollback window 30m.
alice: Smoke test owner? We need someone on standby for the 30m canary window.
priya: I'll be on smoke for staging canary. Will post results in this thread.
marco: Heads-up — small doc tweak found after tag; non-blocking but I'll open a patch PR and target 20:30 PT if needed.
ben: One more heads-up: release branch needs a quick sync with main for the last security patch. I can handle the cherry-pick after smoke passes.
alice: Ok timeline recap: cutoff 18:00 PT (2h). Canary in staging ~18:10 PT. Smoke owner @priya. Docs signoff by @dana done after changelog. Security block: SEC-213 noted, not blocking. If smoke passes, @ben will cherry-pick and push final branch. If anything fails, call it out here and we'll gate.
priya: Canary started. Running basic end-to-end flows now.
priya: Canary results: auth flow ok, long-prompt generation latency within expected band, one 500 in reranker when under concurrent 8—investigating.
ben: Noted the 500. Do we have stack traces? Can you paste logs?
priya: ```ERROR: reranker: index out of range at kvcache.cpp:142``` Looks like a race in hot cache eviction. Repro on staging with synthetic load.
alice: This might be enough to block. @runtime-team ping. Can we hotfix or do we rollback canary?
marco: I can try a quick revert of the last cache tweak to the canary image and re-run. If it repros consistently, we should rollback.
dana: Docs hold until we confirm stability. I'll stop the scheduled post.
priya: Re-run on reverted image now.
priya: Re-run results: no 500s in the same load profile. Good signal.
alice: OK — decision: rollback previous canary, deploy reverted image to staging, re-run canary window. @ben hold the branch cut until we confirm one clean canary window.
ben: Rollback acknowledged. Removing tag `v0.23.0-rc1` locally, will await final confirmation before re-tag.
deploy-bot: rollback completed for canary at 18:34 PT.
priya: New canary run looks clean. No 500s. Smoke green.
dana: Docs: ready to publish changelog + upgrade note after final tag.
marco: Security: SEC-213 updated with the low severity note and mitigations. Marked as acknowledged.
alice: Final checklist: 1) smoke green (yes), 2) changelog merged (yes), 3) docs signoff (yes), 4) security acknowledged (yes), 5) branch sync/cherry-pick (ben to do), 6) final tag and release cut. @ben proceed when ready.
ben: Cherry-pick applied, pushing release branch and creating final tag `v0.23.0`. PR #4292 created for the branch bump.
priya: Quick CR ping on #4292 — approving now.
marco: Approved docs PR. All set.
deploy-bot: release cut queued. Deploy window scheduled at 19:00 PT.
alice: Great work team, thanks for being nimble on the cache issue. I'll close the postmortem thread after the release if any follow-ups needed. :tada:
